From 5f8dec200923a76dc57187965fd59c1136f5d085 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Dmitry Baryshkov <dmitry.baryshkov@linaro.org>
Date: Sun, 3 Dec 2023 01:55:52 +0300
Subject: [PATCH] drm/drv: propagate errors from drm_modeset_register_all()

In case the drm_modeset_register_all() function fails, its error code
will be ignored. Instead make the drm_dev_register() bail out in case of
such an error.

Fixes: 79190ea2658a ("drm: Add callbacks for late registering")
Reviewed-by: Neil Armstrong <neil.armstrong@linaro.org>
Signed-off-by: Dmitry Baryshkov <dmitry.baryshkov@linaro.org>
Signed-off-by: Maxime Ripard <mripard@kernel.org>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20231202225552.1283638-1-dmitry.baryshkov@linaro.org

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/drm_drv.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/drm_drv.c
index 535f16e7882e..3c835c99daad 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/drm_drv.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/drm_drv.c
@@ -949,8 +949,11 @@ int drm_dev_register(struct drm_device *dev, unsigned long flags)
 			goto err_minors;
 	}
 
-	if (drm_core_check_feature(dev, DRIVER_MODESET))
-		drm_modeset_register_all(dev);
+	if (drm_core_check_feature(dev, DRIVER_MODESET)) {
+		ret = drm_modeset_register_all(dev);
+		if (ret)
+			goto err_unload;
+	}
 
 	DRM_INFO("Initialized %s %d.%d.%d %s for %s on minor %d\n",
 		 driver->name, driver->major, driver->minor,
@@ -960,6 +963,9 @@ int drm_dev_register(struct drm_device *dev, unsigned long flags)
 
 	goto out_unlock;
 
+err_unload:
+	if (dev->driver->unload)
+		dev->driver->unload(dev);
 err_minors:
 	remove_compat_control_link(dev);
 	drm_minor_unregister(dev, DRM_MINOR_ACCEL);
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/gpu/drm/drm_drv.c`**
- The code now captures the return value of the `drm_modeset_register_all(dev)` function call and checks if it is non-zero (indicating an error).
- If an error is detected, the code jumps to the `err_unload` label to handle the error appropriately.
- The `err_unload` section has been added to ensure that if the device driver has an unload function, it is called to clean up resources before exiting.
- The previous implementation did not handle the error from `drm_modeset_register_all()`, which could lead to ignoring critical failures.

### Relationships Between Modifications
- The modification enhances error handling in the `drm_dev_register` function by ensuring that any failure from `drm_modeset_register_all()` is properly addressed, preventing the function from proceeding without handling the error.
- This change is directly related to the previous commit identified by the fix tag (`Fixes: 79190ea2658a`), which introduced the `drm_modeset_register_all()` call without adequate error handling. The current patch corrects this oversight, ensuring that the system behaves correctly in the event of a failure during the modeset registration process.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
drm_modeset_register_all(dev);
```
Reason:
The `drm_modeset_register_all()` function is called without checking its return value. If this function fails, the error code is ignored, allowing the `drm_dev_register()` function to continue executing, which can lead to inconsistent device states or resource leaks.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
ret = drm_modeset_register_all(dev);
if (ret)
    goto err_unload;
```
Reason:
The patch modifies the code to capture the return value of `drm_modeset_register_all(dev)` into the `ret` variable. If this function fails (i.e., returns a non-zero value), the code now properly handles the error by jumping to the `err_unload` label, ensuring that the failure is managed and resources are cleaned up appropriately.
